## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
fn tr_count(n: ptr PNode, used: ptr Map, expanded: ptr Map)
  map_set(used, n.kind, map_get(used, n.kind) + 1)
  if n.expanded != null
    for i = 0 to vec_len(n.expanded) - 1
      map_set(expanded, u_get(n.expanded, i), 1)
    end
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nslots(n) - 1
    tr_count(ps_nd(n.svals, i), used, expanded)
  end
  for i = 0 to ps_nitems(n) - 1
    tr_count(ps_nd(n.items, i), used, expanded)
  end
end

fn tr_back(b: ptr StrBuf, r: ptr DrResult, target: str, prefix: str, kind: str, seen: ptr Map)
  let f = map_get(r.back, kind) as ptr PfFile
  if f == null
    return
  end
  let incs = cg_includes(f)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(incs) - 1
    let inc = u_get(incs, i)
    let branch = "├── "
    let more = "│   "
    if i == vec_len(incs) - 1
      branch = "└── "
      more = "    "
    end
    sb_add(b, u_cat4(prefix, branch, "@", u_cat4(target, "/", inc, "\n")))
    if !map_has(seen, inc)
      map_set(seen, inc, 1)
      tr_back(b, r, target, u_cat(prefix, more), inc, seen)
    end
  end
end

fn tr_tree(r: ptr DrResult, file: str, target: str) -> str
  let used = map_new()
  let expanded = map_new()
  tr_count(r.prog.main, used, expanded)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(r.prog.funcs) - 1
    tr_count(ps_nd(r.prog.funcs, i), used, expanded)
  end
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, u_cat(file, "\n"))
  let labels = vec_new()
  let kinds = vec_new()
  let notes = vec_new()
  let names = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to map_len(r.front.front) - 1
    u_push(names, map_key(r.front.front, i))
  end
  u_sort_strs(names)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let n = u_get(names, i)
    let f = map_get(r.front.front, n) as ptr PfFile
    if f.is_truck
      continue
    end
    let k = pf_kind(n)
    if map_has(expanded, n)
      u_push(labels, n)
      u_push(kinds, "")
      u_push(notes, "expands into other packages")
    elif map_get(used, k) > 0
      u_push(labels, n)
      u_push(kinds, k)
      u_push(notes, "")
    end
  end
  if map_get(used, "int") > 0
    u_push(labels, "(integer)")
    u_push(kinds, "int")
    u_push(notes, "")
  end
  if map_get(used, "str") > 0
    u_push(labels, "(string)")
    u_push(kinds, "str")
    u_push(notes, "")
  end
  if map_get(used, "var") > 0
    u_push(labels, "(variable)")
    u_push(kinds, "var")
    u_push(notes, "")
  end
  u_push(labels, "(program)")
  u_push(kinds, "program")
  u_push(notes, "")
  for i = 0 to vec_len(labels) - 1
    let branch = "├── "
    let more = "│   "
    if i == vec_len(labels) - 1
      branch = "└── "
      more = "    "
    end
    let label = rp_pad(u_get(labels, i), 16)
    if u_get(notes, i) != ""
      sb_add(b, u_cat4(branch, label, " ", u_cat(u_get(notes, i), "\n")))
    else
      sb_add(b, u_cat4(branch, label, " → ", u_cat4(target, "/", u_get(kinds, i), "\n")))
      tr_back(b, r, target, more, u_get(kinds, i), map_new())
    end
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
